faq.q1: What does ONBO Solutions do exactly?
faq.a1: We develop custom software, support digital transformation processes and integrate AI where it creates real value. We don't sell catalogue products — we analyse your case and build the solution you need.
faq.a2: Backend and full-stack development, digital transformation and AI consulting, and identification and management of funding calls for innovation projects.
faq.q3: How much does a project cost?
faq.a3: It depends on the scope. We offer a free consultation where we analyse your situation and prepare a no-commitment quote. Most projects start with a technical analysis in under 24 hours.
faq.q4: How long does a project take?
faq.a4: A functional MVP can be ready in 4–8 weeks. More complex projects are planned in phases so you see value from the very first sprint.
faq.a5: We work remotely from Spain. We serve clients from any Spanish-speaking country and also in English.
